  <title>Gateway / Operations console</title>
  <style>
    html,body{margin:0;padding:0;min-height:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:#0c0c10;color:#ececf0;font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui}

    body{min-height:100vh}
    button,a{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
    button{font:inherit}
    button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #d1f798;outline-offset:4px}
    .shell{max-width:1168px;margin:0 auto;padding:28px 32px 24px}
    .topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-bottom:23px;border-bottom:1px solid #27272f}
    .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-size:14px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-.3px}
    .brandmark{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,7px);gap:3px;transform:rotate(-9deg)}
    .brandmark i{width:7px;height:7px;background:#d1f798;border-radius:1px}
    .brandmark i:last-child{opacity:.4}
    .brand span:last-child{color:#72727f;font-weight:450;margin-left:3px}
    .environment{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font:10px ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:1.2px;color:#a5a5b1}
    .environment::before{content:"";width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#d1f798}
    .intro{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;margin:32px 0 27px}
    .eyebrow{font:10px ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:1.7px;color:#a4a4b0;margin:0 0 10px}
    h1{font-size:34px;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-1.4px;font-weight:550;margin:0}
    .subtitle{color:#92929f;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;margin:11px 0 0}
    .action-count{font:10px ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;color:#777784;letter-spacing:1px;padding-bottom:3px;white-space:nowrap}
    .action-count strong{font-size:24px;font-weight:400;color:#b0b0bb;margin

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
  <title>Relay — Operations console</title>
  <style>
    html,body{margin:0;padding:0;min-height:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:#0c0c10;color:#ececf0;font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui}
    *,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
    :root{--muted:#999aa8;--line:#292a35;--blue:#b5c5ff;--green:#bde7ad;--red:#ffabab;--amber:#edce91}
    .shell{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:22px 32px 16px}
    .topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:43px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:17px}
    .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:15px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:2px}
    .brandmark{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,5px);gap:3px;transform:rotate(-12deg)}
    .brandmark i{height:8px;background:var(--blue);border-radius:1px}
    .brandmark i:nth-child(2){opacity:.5}.brandmark i:nth-child(3){opacity:.7}
    .topbar-note{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.035em;color:var(--muted)}
    .topbar-note::before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;margin-right:7px;background:var(--green);border-radius:50%;vertical-align:1px}
    .intro{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin:24px 0 21px}
    h1{font-size:29px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-1px;font-weight:620;margin:0}
    .subtitle{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin:7px 0 0;line-height:1.5}
    .operator{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}
    .avatar{width:32px;height:32px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #373947;border-radius:50%;background:#1b1c26;color:#c4c6d8;font-size:11px}
    .operator strong{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:#dedee6;font-weight:500;font-size:12px}
    .console{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#121218;box-shadow:0 16px 50px #0000
